chunks: "Whoever speaks while at the place of relieving oneself, his need will not be fulfilled."

key_terms.الْخَلَاءِ: the place of relieving oneself; the restroom or privy
key_terms.حَاجَتُهُ: his need; here, the need of relieving oneself
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it has been transmitted or narrated

ai.seo_question: What does Shia hadith say about speaking while in the restroom?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches an etiquette related to relieving oneself, discouraging speech in that state. It indicates that speaking in the restroom or place of relieving oneself is blameworthy and linked to deprivation of having one's need properly fulfilled.
